processDependencyCompleteness.rationale: Although the source is an argument rather than a product tutorial, the audit defines five consequential dependency chains. The candidate covers all five: seller motive to profile check; topic selection versus one-click purchase/adaptation; 60-point premise to novice/established-account consequences; persistence claim to breakthrough explanation; and AI assistance versus script substitution. It does not mistake edited chronology for proof of causal validity.

60-point premise -> audience split -> hypothetical weight consequence
broad opening -> permitted assistance/prohibited substitution -> narrowed close

judgeRationale.readability: The article leads with the opening/closing correction and maintains clear separation between the author's position and verified fact.
judgeRationale.knowledgePrioritization: The main thesis, incentive critique, topic/empathy rationale, 60-point/weight hypothesis, breakthrough claim, and final boundary are ordered by argumentative importance.
judgeRationale.evidenceUsefulness: Time windows are usable and the structured reconstruction resolves visual, subtitle, OCR, shot, and bounded-absence evidence without collapsing conflicts.
judgeRationale.executionValue: The article provides a usable decision boundary and cautions against treating unverified platform claims as rules, but the source itself supplies no operational topic test, platform evidence, or AI fact-checking workflow; the candidate correctly cannot manufacture these.
judgeRationale.compressionWithoutLoss: The public-facing article compresses a dense audit while the structured artifact preserves all core units, conflicts, relations, and unknowns.

metaAudit.rationale: Independent recheck found no carrier, meaning change, or relationship left unguarded. The candidate covers spoken/SRT content, burned captions, opening collage, whiteboard and gestures, persistent presenter/environment referents, technical shot/dense evidence, OCR conflicts, audio-stream inspection, scoped absence review, and non-speech audio uncertainty. It captures the decisive broad-opening-to-narrow-closing relation, both carrier conflicts, all audited argument dependencies, and the distinction between technical cuts and semantic continuity. Identity inversion, literal product result/failure signatures, and UI progress/status are not applicable because the video contains one masked presenter and no product/UI demonstration; the candidate correctly records that absence rather than treating those probes as unchecked. All 20 candidate relation records have distinct endpoints; there is no self-edge.

examples.assessment: The candidate correctly rejects a literal zero-AI summary and reconstructs the ending as AI assistance allowed, AI authorship substitution rejected.
The opening SRT/insert mismatch and closing 智商/最强 self-label conflict are preserved rather than harmonized.
Universal creator claims, 60 points, 1 million followers, 50,000 likes, 3,000 likes, weight, and base distribution are all attributed to the author or hypothetical and explicitly marked unverified.
Absence claims are bounded to the inspected 0-156.367-second internal scope and name the inspected carriers; no universal absence is claimed.
The candidate does not equate 11 detected shots with 11 semantic scenes and correctly notes that one long technical shot contains multiple argument units.
